import { describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import * as mod from "../../src/resolvers/settlement-kind";

describe("settlement classification", () => {
  test("a failed send classifies as a non-attempt", () => {
    const classify: any = (mod as any).settlementKindOf;
    const verdict = classify({ status: "dispatch_failed" });
    expect(verdict).toBe("non_attempt");
  });
});
